The '''kulthka fish''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] found across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. The [[Knowledge Bank]] had a connection with the fish that allowed it to record everything that the fish saw or heard.<ref name="Strongholds" />
